victor krueller.name: Victor Krueller
victor krueller.origin: Years ago, before Wilson Fisk became the Kingpin, he had a "falling out" with an associate named Victor "Kruel" Krueller. Their fight was witnessed by many people at a Pennsylvania diner. Among them were Karen Page, Foggy Nelson, Ben Urich, Glorianna O'Breen, and Kathy Malper. The diner was burned with Kruel inside. Fisk ordered his men to "burn the memories" of the witnesses. Years later, Kruel appeared to be alive and kicking. He started attacking the witnesses from that day to help him remember who tried to kill him. He attacked Ben Urich and killed Glorianna. Daredevil believed he was the reason behind these attacks and warned Kathy Malper. Kathy didn't believe him until Kruel attacked them. Once Kruel recalled another detail about the "fat man" that beat him, he escaped. Later, Daredevil confronted the only person he knew with the knowledge and the resources to attack those closest to Matt Murdock: Wilson Fisk. While Daredevil confronted Kingpin, Krueller arrived and tried to kill them both. Joining forces, Fisk and Murdock were able to kill him before he killed Foggy Nelson.

fields.notes: The Krueller saga ( - , the only Marvel comics written by " e" which is a traditional pseudonym for authors) presents an important timeline inconsistency affecting Karen and other characters. In that story, Krueller had been attacked by a young Kingpin, who was not yet the ruler of crime, and several people witnessed the event including Foggy Nelson, a law student; Karen Page, a struggling actress; and Glorianna O'Breen, who had just migrated to the US. However: Karen started pursuing a career as an actress in (1970). She had been working for Foggy Nelson's firm since (1964), where Foggy was already a lawyer - so at no moment Foggy was a law student and Karen a struggling actress at the same time. Besides, Glorianna O'Breen went to the US in (1984); by then Kingpin was already a very established mob boss (not an up-and-comer) who had clashed with Daredevil since (1981) - and had been seen as a lord of crime since (1967).

victor lillian.name: Victor Lillian
victor lillian.origin: Blistik was a misguided and self-proclaimed "protector of the quality of urban life" in New York City. Effectively a vigilante, with questionable methods of upholding "order" he came into conflict with Captain America. He attacked a group of teens for loud music and blew up a van that nearly killed pedestrians. He then went to deal with Fabian Stankiewicz who was trying to jump off the Brooklyn Bridge. Blistik was annoyed that Fabian was causing a scene and tried to get him to jump quickly. Captain America arrived and tried to save Fabian's life, which annoyed Blistik even more and tried to push Fabian but was stopped by Cap who knocked Blistik into the river. ===Civil War=== Blistik was attacking a construction site when he was again defeated by Captain America. After the Civil War, he was listed as a potential recruit for the Initiative.

victor neumenon.name: Victor Neumenon
victor neumenon.origin: Victor Neumenon was the assistant to Albion Crawley who followed Crawley on his expedition for the The Crossing of the Abyss. They discovered the Arachnix and were captured by them. They tried to consume Crawley but he was able to escape with the help of Victor, who was turned into a Sorrow Fly. After leaving Crawley, Sorrow Fly traveled to the Insect World. While here, he helped send the surviving egg (that would become a Radioactive Spider) to New York City. Many years later, he met Spider-Man who had been sent to kill Sorrow Fly by the Arachnix to prove whether he was a man or a spider and revealed the origin of the spider that bit him before Doctor Strange arrived to retrieve him. Strange turned Victor back into a human and after the Arachnix's defeat, revealed that his human body was long dead and he would be unable to leave this realm.

victor octavius.name: Victor Octavius
victor octavius.species: Human mutate; after being diagnosed with the bubonic plague, Victor Octavius used the blood of octopuses to cure his sickness, but also turning him into a octopus/human hybrid.
victor octavius.origin: Baron Victor Octavius was a Italian nobleman living in France who suffered from the bubonic plague. Octavius attempted to cure himself by using the blood of octopi, which worked, but also slowly transforming him into a human/octopus hybrid. Octavius had since tried to revert his transformation by experimenting on humans and 'Witchbreeds' to find a viable cure and even forcing scientist Henri Le Pym to help him by holding his shrunken wife, Janette Le Pym, hostage. In public, Octavius always kept his entire body hidden from prying eyes and always accompanied with plague doctors. After having been using the blood of his fellow colleague Hal McCoy which slowed his transformation had begun to wain, Octavius learned from Norman Osborne about the Spider and captured him in obtaining his blood for his cure. However, once Henri Le Pym completed the serum, Octavius had ultimately progressed to his complete hybrid form which drove him to madly think that he was a superior life form above humankind. As a result, Octavius turned on Pym and his underlings, and fought the Spider. Just as Octavius had the advantage, he was towered over by a giant Henri Le Pym, who had drank the vial that was used to cure Octavius and Janette's size. Octavius begged Le Pym to spare him, but was then crushed to death by Henri's giant foot.
powers: Tentacles coming out of his back that could be used as weapons.

victor santiago.name: Victor Santiago
victor santiago.origin: Victor Santiago was a Peruvian drug lord who had his assassins attack the judge presiding over his trial in Lima's airport. The guards were killed and the judge was given a warning, the next day the judge declared a mistrial. Victor afterwards told a journalist he knew nothing about the attack and said he was donating money to each of the widows. The Punisher went to his country estate, and battled his way to the top floor where Victor was located. He made it to his room but couldn't get to Victor due to the thick bulletproof glass barrier that sled down. Punisher threatened to wait him out till he died of thirst or starvation, unless he turned himself in, provided testimony to clear an innocent woman, had her child returned to her, and gave him Eduardo one of the hitters involved in the attack. After turning himself he was released and fled to Belize. The Punisher followed him to Belize, a nation that was dealing with private drug armies, Guatemalan rebels, and the Guatemalan army. He intervened on the side of a unit of British-led Gurkhas during a three-sided firefight with the Guatemalan army and rebels, and then went with them to the archaeological camp they were defending. Victor then manipulated the Guatemalan army and rebels to ambush the British patrol, who left only a few guards back at their camp. Santiago himself led his own men in an assault on the camp. They quickly took out the guards, leaving only the Punisher to protect the archaeologists. During the firefight, the remnants of the British patrol and Guatemalan forces appeared turning it into a four way firefight. Santiago's private army was nearly annihilated and a Gurkha killed the drug lord.

victor slaughter.name: Victor Slaughter
victor slaughter.species: Human infected with a strain of pseudo vampirism
victor slaughter.origin: ===Early Life=== Victor "Vic" Slaughter served in the US Marine whose squad was on specialized assignments for the CIA. On such mission his team was sent to Central America for three years, they all died leaving Vic the soul survivor. This lead to PTSD when he returned to the States, he eventually recovered forming his own mercenary team known as the Hardcases. ===Hunt for Morbius=== Simon Stroud former CIA agent hired Vic to hunt and take down Morbius, the Living Vampire as part of his personal vendetta. The team waited at a nearby cemetery for the arrival of the pseudo-vampire. He was there to visit the grave of Martine Bancroft. They shot at him with everything they had believing they killed him, however Morbius leapt on Vic. He tried to shoot at Morbius with a more powerful explosive but did not have a chance as Morbius bit him on the neck, and broke several bones, attempting to find out who hired Slaughter. Failing at this, Morbius tossed him into an open grave and buried him alive. ===Return from the Grave=== At sunrise he dug his way out of the grave was revenge on Morbius. He was taken to the nearby St. Jude's Hospital buy Morbius in his identity of "Dr. Morgan Michaels". He was questioned by two police detectives, but he fellow unconscious and had to be taken to intensive care. He was fitted with cast to set his broken limbs. He began to change becoming pale and his body dropped drastically. When a nurse arrived to change his blood he attacked her draining her dry. He then went on a killing spree across the city. Morbius tried to stop him and pushed him in front of a train, but he survived healing from his wounds. He went to Stroud but Morbius had wiped his memory through hypnosis. He disarmed him and returned his erased memory. He revealed that he had left town after learning of his identity of "Dr. Morgan Michaels". A confrontation between Slaughter, Morbius and the Nightstalkers ended with Morbius believing Slaughter dead. He survived and was hired by the Maggia (and later the CIA) to capture a rogue CIA agent. This led him into conflict with Morbius, Spider-Man and Simon Stroud. ===The Unkillables=== left|200px|thumb A man named Winsor hired Vic to join his team of Unkillables. The teams first mission was to retrieve Harry Sikes an immortal man who was buried in the 1950s. Vic and Suicide went on a hunt for Wolverine and attacked the Mutant hero. They captured Wolverine and took him to Winsor's laboratory. Winsor allowed Vic to feed a little bit on Logan but found it difficult to digest. Vic and the team attacked Logan, but while in his gaseous form Vic was breathed in by Scavenger and trapped inside his body. Winsor's son Flip used his powers to free Vic from Scavengers body. He along with the Unkillables ate Winsor to stop the threat. The team decided to remain together forming their own mercenary crew. Slaughter later appeared fighting Gambit at the behest of Mr. Nil.
weaknesses: Like a vampire, Victor Slaughter must feed on humans or he will weaken.

victor vandoom.name: Victor Vandoom
victor vandoom.origin: Victor Vandoom was the great-grandson of Ludwig Vandoom, the creator of a giant wax monster. He set out to create his own monstrous creatures for his own personal gain, working from the abandoned Castle Kruger in Lichtenbad. He perfected his monster serum using the lingering traces of the formula used on Todd Ziller, the depowered American Kaiju. When Deadpool infiltrated Castle Kruger, Vandoom injected him with his new serum to test it, and let him go. On the outskirts of the castle, the monstrous Deadpool stumbled upon Red Hulk, who had been sent to Lichtenbad to retrieve Ziller, and a battle broke out due to Deadpool's inability to properly communicate. Vandoom filmed the fight with hidden cameras to use the footage to promote his creation. Shortly before Deadpool's healing factor cured him of the serum's mutation and he stopped Red Hulk from fighting, Vandoom injected Ziller with his serum in repayment for his help, turning him back into the American Kaiju. Vandoom continued observing as the American Kaiju targeted Red Hulk and Deadpool. However, his gloating over the Kaiju's prowess was cut short when Red Hulk grabbed the monster by the tail and flung him against Castle Kruger, collapsing the building and seemingly killing Vandoom in the process.

victor von doom clone.name: Victor von Doom (Clone)
victor von doom clone.origin: ===Creation=== Seeking both to satisfy an archaic Latverian law requiring dictators to abdicate after a set term and to improve his standing with the United Nations, Doctor Doom devised a scheme in which he would publicly step down in favor of a supposed son while secretly maintaining control. He instructed his scientist Gert Hauptmann to grow a genetic duplicate of himself, granting the clone at least some of his memories so that he could convincingly impersonate Doom's heir as Victor von Doom II. To support this plan and enable a global power grab, Doom also established Cynthian Associates as a United States based research front and installed the clone there to oversee a project to develop a sophisticated mind-control device capable of swaying the United Nations. ===Cynthian Associates=== At a time when the Fantastic Four had disbanded after Reed Richards lost his stretching powers and felt he could no longer lead the team, Reed accepted a position at Cynthian Associates, unaware of Doom's involvement. From a hidden command center, Doom's clone monitored Richards via remote systems as Reed quickly solved problems that had baffled Doom's prior hires, furthering the development of the mind-control device that would be used against the United Nations. Under the clone's supervision, Hauptmann deployed Doom's Hypno-Persuader to brainwash Reed, turning him into the helmeted costumed figure known as the Invincible Man. Armed with advanced illusions and technology provided by Doom, the Invincible Man tracked down and defeated the scattered Fantastic Four members and delivered them to a Doom-controlled mansion in upstate New York, reassembling the team on Doom's terms. There the clone first revealed himself openly to the captive heroes, exposed that Reed had been their attacker, restored Reed's mind, and had all four imprisoned as raw material for Doom's looming power-transfer experiment. Recognising that Doom required Reed's elastic abilities to be present and active for the transfer, the clone participated in a plan to send Richards into an unshielded spacecraft to re-expose him to cosmic radiation and reawaken his powers. During the flight, Reed was attacked by the Red Ghost, but survived a crash and was recovered by S.H.I.E.L.D., finally deducing Doom's hand behind Cynthian Associates and preparing to confront him. ===Heir of Latveria=== While Reed regrouped with his teammates, Doom brought his clone to Latveria and introduced Victor von Doom II to the Fantastic Four and the Latverian public as his long-hidden son and chosen successor to the Latverian throne. This carefully staged revelation supported Doom's claim that he would soon step aside in accordance with Latverian law while still ensuring that his apparent heir would be entirely loyal to him. In Castle Doom, Doom had the Fantastic Four captured and placed in containment globes attached to a massive transference machine, positioning the clone in a focal harness so that he could receive their combined powers. Doom activated the device intending to strip the team of their abilities and create a new superhuman monarch with all their strengths. ===Flawed transference and rebellion=== Unbeknownst to Doom, Reed had prepared a micro-feedback system in his belt specifically to disrupt any attempt to tamper with his powers. When the transference machine came online, the feedback sabotaged the process so that the Fantastic Four retained their abilities while the clone still absorbed a partial, unstable version of their powers. At the same time, Doom seized Alicia Masters as a hostage to force the heroes to surrender, then proceeded with a formal coronation in which he publicly crowned the clone as Victor von Doom II, heir to Latveria. During the ceremony, resistance leader Zorba Fortunov and the Latverian underground stormed the hall and exposed the supposed prince as a clone, revealing Doom's deception before the gathered court. thumb|left|Dr Doom kills his clone Outraged, Doom unleashed his Omni-Bots against the rebels and the Fantastic Four even as the flawed transference completed, transforming the clone into a rocky hybrid form somewhere between Doom and the Thing. The change horrified the clone but also broke Doom's psychological hold, allowing him to recognise Doom's manipulations of his people and the world. Now wielding a diminished version of the Fantastic Four's combined powers, the clone chose to side with the Latverian rebels and the Fantastic Four against his "father," confronting Doom in open battle in the throne room. He used stretching limbs, flame projection, force fields, and his enhanced strength against Doom in a personal duel, but Doom, enraged at this perceived betrayal and the loss of his handsome features, eventually activated the full output of his armor's electromagnetic systems at close range, killing the clone. ===Aftermath=== Doom furiously blamed the Fantastic Four for forcing him to slay his "son" even as their conflict and Zorba's

victor von doom paper memory.name: Victor von Doom (Paper Memory)
victor von doom paper memory.origin: This Doctor Doom was unwittingly created by Gwenpool from the recollections she possessed of the real Doom. In the Gutter Space, Gwen had noticed that the remaining page count for her comic book series was low, so in an attempt to become relevant and prolong her series' lifespan, she set out to kill Doom, who had turned a new leaf and was going by the alias of Iron Man. After luring Doom into a fight, Gwen was disgruntled in seeing he was now a good guy, as it represented a wrench in her plans. When she sliced him with a sword, from his wound this "paper memory" of Doctor Doom magically emerged. Gwenpool attempted to exile him into the Gutter Space, but as a master of magic, he found his way back quickly. Doom resumed the fight, and overpowered Gwen. While she was trying to escape, Doom teleported both of them to the Gutter Space. The real Doom appeared soon after, having recovered from his magical wound, and destroyed his duplicate swiftly, revealing in the process that its interior was made up of nothing but paper.

victoria lady.name: Victoria (Lady)
victoria lady.origin: Victoria was a resident of Erewhon, a hidden settlement in the South American jungle established as a refuge for criminals and fugitives from the law. When the Punisher was lured to Erewhon by its criminal inhabitants, Victoria was present at the local bar alongside Oswald Zinn, Gottlieb, and several other criminals. She was instructed to get Harvey Long a beer when he arrived in the village, and later became involved in the plan to use Wolverine as a "dancing bear" for the settlement's amusement. After Wolverine entered the bar looking for Harvey, Victoria attempted to gain his confidence. She told him that she knew where Harvey Long was and asked him to return that night so she could tell him what she knew. Before he left, she kissed him on the cheek and asked him to come back. Victoria subsequently met Wolverine again and secretly asked him to help her escape Erewhon. When he refused, she told him that Harvey Long was dead. Gottlieb witnessed their departure and accused Victoria of breaking Erewhon's sacred laws, declaring that he could therefore do whatever he wished with her. Victoria continued fleeing through the jungle with Wolverine, who eventually decided to help her escape. When the sound of gunfire erupted from Erewhon, Wolverine initially returned to help the Punisher. Victoria admitted that the entire situation had been a trap designed to lure Castle into Erewhon and that Wolverine had also been drawn into it. She pleaded with him not to leave her, warning that the others would kill her. Victoria then attempted to convince Wolverine to stay with her, offering him love and a future outside Erewhon and suggesting that his attachment to the Punisher was the only life he was suited for. However, they were ambushed by O'Higgins and several other criminals. While the men opened fire on Wolverine, O'Higgins seized Victoria. Victoria begged O'Higgins to let her go, claiming that she had never caused him trouble and that she had always had a soft spot for him. O'Higgins responded that he had a soft spot for her as well, before shooting her in the chest. Despite her mortal wound, Victoria survived long enough to see Wolverine break free and kill the men who had attacked them. As she lay dying, she told him that when she first saw him, she believed he would be the man capable of taking her away from Erewhon and bringing her home. Wolverine assured her that she had not been wrong. Victoria subsequently died in Wolverine's arms.

victoria anderson.name: Victoria Anderson
victoria anderson.origin: Victoria Anderson was the granddaughter of Professor Phineas T. Horton, the scientist responsible for creating the original Human Torch. She attended Pennsylvania State University, where she studied robotic engineering as a condition of an inheritance left by her grandfather. Although Victoria struggled with her studies, Horton had also bequeathed her a necklace containing a Solar Gem, a device connected to his research into artificial intelligence. While attending a lecture, Victoria was unknowingly observed through a surveillance camera by the Gremlin, a rogue synthezoid developed from technology stolen from Horton. The Gremlin subsequently hijacked an aircraft and traveled to Pennsylvania in pursuit of her. During a party, Victoria encountered a fellow student named Dave, who attempted to make advances toward her. Shortly afterward, she was approached by the Vision, whose damaged appearance frightened her. Victoria initially fled but was persuaded to listen to him by Derek Hoffman, a young boy accompanying the android. Vision explained his connection to Horton and showed Victoria photographs of her grandfather's research. When the Solar Gem embedded in Vision's forehead reacted with Victoria's necklace, the devices activated a prerecorded holographic message from Horton. The recording revealed that a prototype Solar Gem had been stolen by a German spy before World War II and used to develop the Gremlins, artificial beings responsible for sabotaging Allied aircraft. Horton had subsequently attempted to eliminate the machines using the Human Torch, but their leader survived. He had left the recording to help Victoria and Vision destroy the Gremlin should it return. Their meeting was interrupted when Victoria became frightened by Vision's behavior and fled. She attempted to escape in her car, but the Gremlin seized control of the vehicle, transporting her and Derek to a nearby Air Force base. There, they discovered that the Gremlin had taken control of the body of Derek's father, Steve Hoffman, and commandeered military equipment to confront Vision. During the ensuing confrontation, the Gremlin captured Victoria and brought her aboard a B-52 Stratofortress. It explained that its programming was intended to spread fear and destruction, despite possessing the potential to benefit humanity. Victoria challenged its reasoning, arguing that her grandfather would never have approved of its actions and that the Gremlin represented a failed experiment. After Vision freed Steve Hoffman from the Gremlin's control, Victoria devised a plan to defeat the rogue machine. She suggested allowing the Gremlin to assimilate Vision, believing his internal defenses could destroy it. When the Gremlin attempted to merge with Vision, the android's immune system attacked the invading machine. Vision then altered his density, trapping the Gremlin within his body until it was destroyed. The remaining prototype Solar Gem was subsequently destroyed by Vision to prevent the Gremlin's return. Following the confrontation, Victoria thanked Vision for his assistance and acknowledged that her grandfather had ultimately wanted his inventions to benefit humanity. She recognized that Vision had succeeded where Horton had failed by preventing the Gremlin from causing further destruction. When Vision explained that he needed to return to his friends, Victoria encouraged him to remain in contact. She also reminded him that, through their shared connection to Horton, they could consider themselves family. Vision accepted her sentiment and departed with a renewed sense of belonging.

victoria creed.name: Victoria Creed
victoria creed.origin: After Victoria Creed's eldest son Luther was killed by her second son Victor, Victor was locked up in the family cellar. But one day Victor escaped, murdered his father (who had been treating Victor poorly in his captivity) and ran away from home. In later years, Victor told people that he had killed his mother as well, but he in fact hid her away and provided a life of luxury for her for years, visiting her every other week and bringing her expensive gifts. Eventually, Victoria developed cancer, so Victor took her to the most expensive nursing home in the country. She was killed a few years later by a member of the Red Right Hand whose husband Victor had murdered.

victoria grail.name: Victoria Grail
victoria grail.origin: ===Early Life=== Dr. Victoria Grail became suspicious of Dr. Arthur Harrow who was a selected candidate for the Nobel Prize in medicine for his work in the field of pain theory. She did not believe he only carried out limited research on animals. Dr. Grail raised an objection to his nomination when she traced documents relating to secret experiments by scientists in Auschwitz-Birkenau back to Harrow. The documents had been ordered to be destroyed by the Nuremberg Tribunal but had mysteriously disappeared, thanks to the group known as O.M.N.I.U.M.. Despite allegedly being in Mexico to research the jaguar and armadillo, Dr. Grail was certain that Dr. Harrow was carrying on the Auschwitz experiments and was sent by the Nobel Committee to interview him and report back to Stockholm. ===Moon Knight=== 300px|left|thumb|Moon Knight's Vision Marc Spector was driving when the Priests of Khonshu appeared to him, causing him to smash his automobile and sending him mental visions of Dr. Harrow, one of his subjects, Dr. Grail, and the pyramid. O.M.N.I.U.M. was alerted to Dr. Grail being in Yucatan and dispatched agents to apprehend her. At knife point they pushed her into a van, but the kidnapping was spotted by Marc, who quickly transformed into Moon Knight and freed her. Dr. Grail was dismissive of Moon Knight at first, but when he asked her about a scarred man, she understood they were both looking for the same man. Moon Knight and Dr. Grail, found his lab and Dr. Harrow saw them and set a jaguar on them. Moon Knight took out the cat with ease by throwing it against a wall and shocking it. They found a false wall and knocked it in with a desk, revealing steps leading down to the lab. His patients surrounded the pair, and he ordered them to kill them. Moon Knight was warned by Dr. Grail, not to hurt the innocent laborers, yet even his most powerful fists had little effect on them. Moon Knight accidently broke the arm of one of the subjects, who never noticed the injury. Moon Knight realised he couldn't defeat them without causing substantial damage, so he chose to flee. He was able to yank the strong steel door from its hinges, allowing him and Dr. Grail, to flee the pyramid. Dr. Harrow escaped in a helicopter, as they through an incendiary at them. Unbeknownst to Dr. Gail, Harrow would continue in Paraguay.
abilities: Genius Intelligence: Dr. Gail was a brilliant scientist.

Moon Knight and Dr. Grail, found his lab and Dr. Harrow saw them and set a jaguar on them. Moon Knight took out the cat with ease by throwing it against a wall and shocking it. They found a false wall and knocked it in with a desk, revealing steps leading down to the lab. His patients surrounded the pair, and he ordered them to kill them. Moon Knight was warned by Dr. Grail, not to hurt the innocent laborers, yet even his most powerful fists had little effect on them. Moon Knight accidently broke the arm of one of the subjects, who never noticed the injury. Moon Knight realised he couldn't defeat them without causing substantial damage, so he chose to flee. He was able to yank the strong steel door from its hinges, allowing him and Dr. Grail, to flee the pyramid. Dr. Harrow escaped in a helicopter, as they through an incendiary at them. Unbeknownst to Dr. Gail, Harrow would continue in Paraguay.

victoria von frankenstein.name: Victoria von Frankenstein
victoria von frankenstein.origin: Victoria von Frankenstein lived with the dwarvish creations of her grandfather, Basil, and her father, Ludwig, which she called "the Children", in Castle Frankenstein. Ivan, the former servant of Victoria's great-grandfather, Vincent, located Frankenstein's Monster at Castle Frankenstein, convinced him that his new master, Dr. Walston Kraft, could give him a "real body," and took him to Kraft's castle in Switzerland. Ivan then returned to Castle Frankenstein and imprisoned Victoria in its dungeon to prevent her from interfering. Kraft succeeded in making an army of Frankenclones without the Monster's knowledge. Spider-Man flew to the Alps as Perer Parker to cover a story on Kraft and the International Council on Cloning and Genetic Research. Understandably uncomfortable with cloning due to his past experience with the subject, Peter knew something was up after running into both the Monster and Ivan, the latter of whom threatened him while he was snooping around Kraft's castle. Spider-Man traveled to Castle Frankenstein, where he found and freed Victoria and learned what had been going on. Spider-Man exposed the plot to the Monster, and they both destroyed Kraft's laboratory and castle and foiled his plot. The Monster then left Spider-Man to return to Castle Frankenstein with Victoria. Years later, Victoria had changed her surname to "Fronken-Schteen" and became an attendee of the Guernica Bar. When a group of villains arrived there asking to hide there because one of them was hurt, she managed to cure him, but stated that criminals should not have to come there in the future, because she did not want this place to became a safe haven for villains. She became a friend of Wolverine and when he was hit by a mysterious bullet, she extracted it from Logan's shoulder in order to examine it with other attendees of the bar. She was even present when some of Sabretooth's ninjas attacked the bar in order to kill Robert Templeton, who could find out where Sabretooth was hiding. Along with the attendees and with a little help from Wolverine and Thor, Victoria was able to both defeat the ninjas and aid Wolverine in his war against Sabretooth.

victory.name: Victory
victory.origin: Victory the Electromagnetic Man, a member of the Squadron Sinister, was present when his team confronted the Avengers on behalf of the Grandmaster. He was pitted against the Avenger Voyager in Pisa, Italy. As soon as the fight started, Voyager's Portal Field reacted with Victory's own Electro-Field, resulting in a devastating explosion that outright disintegrated Victory, while Voyager was phased out of existence. On Earth-616, Voyager was not a member of the Avengers. She was instead a sleeper agent sent by the Grandmaster to infiltrate the group of heroes during a challenge against the Challenger. In order to succeed in her plan, Voyager altered the memories of the Avengers to make them believe she was a long-standing member. These memory alterations mirrored the events surrounding Victory's death.
powers: Electro-Field: Victory possessed the ability to project an energy field that could alter the electromagnetic spectrum. It allegedly granted him contol over reality itself.

videmus.name: Videmus
videmus.origin: Videmus was a member of the Genetic Council and an Inhuman. Terrigenesis rendered Videmus blind, but gave him the ability to attach to others in order to see through them, also giving him the ability to see their thoughts and retain the memories they shared. Videmus used this power to allow people to share their thoughts with each other. When Pietro Maximoff sought refuge in Attilan following the Decimation, hoping that the Inhumans would allow him to undergo terrigenesis to restore his powers, Videmus befriended him. Videmus aided Pietro in stealing part of the crystals, robbing the Inhumans of their terrigenesis. After turning himself in to King Black Bolt, he revealed that he did so because he believed that the Inhumans seeking refuge on the Moon would dull their warrior instincts and leave them unprepared for the hardships of the future. By robbing them of terrigenesis, he hoped to once again plunge his people into uncertainty, forcing them to fight for the privilege of terrigenesis. As punishment for his crimes, Black Bolt decreed that Videmus was to live out his life in solitary confinement, forbidden from ever again joining his mind to another living soul.
powers: Tactile Telepathy: Videmus is blind but he can attach his eyes to the foreheads of others to see their thoughts, and retains the memories they share.

He was found by The Thing and they fought with Ben overpowering the Vigil and the Vigil was trapped under rubble. he demanded the Thing kill him, but Ben refused and then saved the Vigil from a roof collapse. The Vigil deemed the Thing worthy and gave him the crystal. After Ben left, the Vigil set up another crystal and waited for the next person he would deem worthy.

viktor mutant.name: Viktor (Mutant)
viktor mutant.origin: Nothing is known of Viktor's past. He was a nightclub owner in Prague who was secretly a brutal human trafficker, preying on other mutants who sought jobs at his club and selling them to the highest bidder. One of his "clients" was the corrupt DermaFree Corporation, which the mutant spy Mystique had been sent to bring down. To do that, she infiltrated Viktor's gang as a customer, stating an intent to buy one of his captive mutants. Once Viktor led her to the holding cell where the mutants were being kept, Mystique attacked, stabbing Viktor in the back with a knife. Viktor struck back, entangling Mystique and Luc, one of his captives who had come to her defense, with his tentacles, before being felled by a burst of light from another one of the enslaved mutants, Tanya. An enraged Mystique then dragged Viktor off and stabbed him to death.

viktor komolov.name: Viktor Komolov
viktor komolov.origin: A high-ranking member of the Solntsevskaya Bratva, Viktor Komolov learned the ways of black magic, and shared his knowledge with his men. With these powers, Komolov set out to bring back Omega Red back from the dead. To this end, he made a deal with the Hand, trading them victims of human-trafficking in exchange for the coffin that contained the remains of Omega Red, Komolov and his men subsequently carried out a ritual that resulted in Omega Red's rebirth. However, this was temporary, which required Omega Red to regularly feed on people's life energy. And even then, that only delayed his body's inevitable decay. Komolov's right hand Anatoly Rasputin was the estranged uncle of powerful sorceress and X-Men member Magik. Under the pretense he was tipping them off about Omega Red's return, Anatoly lured the X-Men to Russia, and set up an ambush during which Komolov's men kidnapped Magik, with the intention to force her to empower Omega Red and prevent his decay. Even though Komolov had already forced Magik to strengthen Omega Red when the X-Men attacked his base, they managed to rescue their teammate and defeat Komolov, who was subsequently taken into custody by S.I.C.K.L.E..
abilities: Black Magic: Viktor is proficient in the black arts.

vin corsico.name: Vin Corsico
vin corsico.origin: Vin Corsico was a superpowered sex offender who volunteered for Project Echelon, a U.S. government super-soldier program. While at a military research facility, Corsico was killed by the Red She-Hulk, who snapped his neck. Unaware that she had fatally injured him, the Red She-Hulk ordered one of the scientists to resuscitate him, only to be informed that Corsico had no vital signs. She subsequently ordered everyone in the facility to evacuate. After the building collapsed, Machine Man arrived at the site and determined that the staff had successfully evacuated. He discovered Corsico's body among the wreckage and attempted to revive him with electronic jolts, but ultimately pronounced him dead.

vin tak.name: Vin-Tak
vin tak.origin: Vin-Tak was a Kree who came to Earth after he received a signal indicating that a Diviner had been activated. He came armed with a truncheon that could take away the memories of anyone who was jabbed with it, and used nitrogen to dye his naturally blue skin the color of a Caucasian human's. The Asgardians sent the warrior Lady Sif to Earth after him, as they did not trust the Kree. She tracked Vin-Tak to Portugal, but he managed to erase her memories during a fight. Vin-Tak escaped to a nearby hospital, where he used their stores of liquid nitrogen to dye his skin again. However, Vin-Tak's actions also attracted the attention of S.H.I.E.L.D.. Two S.H.I.E.L.D. agents, Bobbi Morse and Skye found Vin-Tak at the hospital and challenged him. While they were fighting, a small earthquake broke out, giving Vin-Tak an opportunity to escape. He made his way to the city of Chaves, where he found a crate containing Terrigen Crystals, but S.H.I.E.L.D. managed to track him there and corner him while he was leaving. Vin-Tak put up a fight, but one of the agents fired an electrified net towards him that knocked him out. S.H.I.E.L.D. took him into custody and started questioning him aboard their plane. Vin-Tak tried to explain his purpose on Earth, and said he only wanted to help. When they got back to S.H.I.E.L.D.'s headquarters, Vin-Tak used his truncheon to return Sif's memories. He explained why he was on Earth, as well as his people's history on Earth and Terrigenesis. While he was explaining this to them, one of S.H.I.E.L.D.'s scientists, Jemma Simmons, discovered the crate Vin-Tak found was empty. Realizing his worst fears has come true, he urged S.H.I.E.L.D. to help him find the remaining Terrigen crystals, and anyone who had been transformed by them. He soon discovered Skye was one of the people who had recently undergone Terrigenesis, and he and Sif tried to convince S.H.I.E.L.D.'s director Phil Coulson to hand her over to them. Coulson refused, and Skye escaped to the facility's jail cell, but Vin-Tak and Sif chased after them. Agent Morse, however, managed to distract Vin-Tak away from Skye. During their fight, Agent Morse got her hands on Vin-Tak's truncheon and erased his own memories with it. The two aliens eventually agreed to let Skye stay on Earth. Sif took Vin-Tak back with her to Asgard, promising to give him safe passage back to Hala.
weapons: Truncheon

vinatos.name: Vinatos
vinatos.species: Inhuman subjected to the Terrigen Mists
vinatos.origin: Vinatos was the Medical Regent in charge of the health and well-being of the the Inhuman Royal Family. After the fall of their city Attilan, Queen Medusa tasked Vinatos with the examination of the new Inhuman Inferno, his sister, Gabriela, and the cocoon of their deceased mother. Dante became very ill-tempered and told Vinatos to stay away from his family. Vinatos then got verbal after Dante insulted Queen Medusa, but Medusa told Vinatos to let it go, saying that the boy was unfamiliar with their customs. He would later assist Kamala Khan after a violent encounter and would introduce Kamala to her nature as an Inhuman. Vinatos would perish confronting by The Unspoken who had taken over the city of Attilan. As he distracted the tyrant, the latter killed him with a powerful energy blast, as The Unspoken recalled Vinatos had not supported him when the former was driven from the throne. Inferno, Naja and Flint then succeeded in defeating The Unspoken. During his funeral, Queen Medusa (having been affected by the inversion spell while in Genosha ) threw his coffin into the sea.

vince garone.name: Vince Garone
vince garone.origin: Vince Garone was crime boss who was a bootlegger during Prohibition. In the 1940s, he decided to establish a legitimate business and started up a trucking company. While his business was legal, his methods of dealing with the competition were far from. He had his gang pressure competing truckers to join his company. Those who refused were driven off the road to their deaths. When Garone's men threatened trucker Hank Steel, Steel refused to give into Garone. When Steel became Garone's next target, it attracted the attention of the other-dimensional Vision who smashed Garone's gang. As Garone attempted to flee the scene, the Vision used his illusion casting powers to frighten Garone off the road. His car drove off a cliff to a fatal crash, a fitting end for someone who sent so many innocent men to the same fate.

vincent cetewayo.origin: Vincent Cetewayo was a political activist born in Imaya. fields.personality: Vincent Cetewayo was a political activist who dedicated his life to coordinating the efforts of relief agencies to maximize their effectiveness, and to exerting political and diplomatic pressure on situations he felt required someone to do so, in addition to exposing injustices and abuses of power around the world, maintaining the greatest possible political neutrality to protect the innocent from those who have no qualms about harming others to maintain their power. Cetewayo firmly believed in the sanctity of liberty, the sacredness of life, and the rights of the individual. His trusted associate Rebecca Bergier believed that Cetewayo had worked his entire life to prevent wars, although there were times when he approved of armed conflict to defend innocents. Before beginning that career, Cetewayo had been a prisoner in Imaya during the Letumba government, and his jailer, the brutal and erratic Eda Arul, remembered (or thought he remembered) that Cetewayo had mocked him when he had brought him food and cleaned his "filth." Cetewayo was a brave man who challenged more powerful people publicly and openly (for example, when he was recaptured by Arul, who had become dictator, Cetewayo was unwilling to address Arul as Your Excellency and antagonized Arul instead, knowing that the sadistic Arul would beat him up), but he took care to be polite to his friends and potential friends, and he remembered many people he had encountered in his life: When Cetewayo gave a lecture at the University of California, Berkeley, student Michael Collins asked him many very good questions, and Cetewayo remembered him years later. Cetewayo encountered the supernatural creature called the Advisor, who used different faces, in various places, and he also He remembered him even when the Advisor had changed his identity. Cetewayo formed a relationship with his trusted associates Rebecca Bergier and Dr. Ranald Jeffries, who would go on to become Worldwatch's executive board, and he was also aware of several other people he had not yet met but had potential as allies, such as James Rhodes. When they finally met, Rhodes found Cetewayo to be surprisingly cheerful for someone who had seen so much evil; Cetewayo suggested that it was because he still had hope that the world could change for the better. Cetewayo was a persuasive man, and also a gentleman: When he made an offer and his interlocutor rejected it, Cetewayo accepted that the other person had made a decision and did not insist, as when Rhodes did not want to lead Worldwatch (Cetewayo even asked Bergier not to insist) and when Deathlok (Collins) refused to join an armed resistance. However, in both cases, he was able to reach a brief compromise: With Rhodes, he convinced him to accept and read the book Cetewayo had written, hoping he would change his mind, and with Deathlok, to get him to smuggle wounded combatants out of the conflict zone. As Dr. Jeffries would later state, Cetewayo had learned to be secretive and not reveal his cards before time. At the end of his life, Cetewayo decided he was offered the opportunity to join an armed resistance against dictator Eda Arul, who had been in power for fifteen years in his home country of Imaya. To the surprise of everyone, Cetewayo wanted to join the conflict, even if it required him to fight personally. However, before he could actively contribute, Cetewayo was intercepted by the Advisor, who revealed at least part of his plans and nature to him, shocking him with his inhuman cruelty. Although Cetewayo had stoically endured torture at the hands of Arul just days before, knowing that Arul planned to execute him, Cetewayo begged the Advisor for his life so he could return to the people Cetewayo loved and continue his work. The Advisor killed Cetewayo in a way that minimized his work, but acknowledged that Cetewayo was a fascinating person.

fields.trivia: When Cetewayo first met James Rhodes in person, Cetewayo said he wanted to found Worldwatch, suggesting that he had not done it yet. However, by the time Cetewayo was kidnapped just a couple days later, Worldwatch was already founded and the staff was already hired, as Rhodes would find out after returning to Los Angeles from Imaya. Jeffries told Rhodes that Cetewayo was cautious about revealing details. Watching the Imayan Civil War on TV, Cetewayo's associate Rebecca Bergier said that Cetewayo had worked all his life to end that kind of conflict, but he was being blamed for it. However, at that point, Cetewayo had actively joined the armed resistance against Arul, which suggests that maybe Bergier did not know Cetewayo as well as she believed.

vincent dio.name: Vincent Dio
vincent dio.origin: Vincent "Vince" Dio is the brother of Jack "Jackie" Dio. They both worked under Silvermane just prior to the surge in super-humans and costumed beings in the New York crime scene, both as superheroes and super-villains. Vince saw that super-human enhancement was the way of the future, however, after their father's death at the hands of a costumed criminal, Jack was vehemently against allowing super criminals into organized crime. Charged with taking care of his brother Vince, Jackie and Vince came to blows over bringing in super criminals into their criminal activities. Vince eventually overstepped his boundaries, and Jackie beat him senseless and told him to leave town. Vince then worked with the police in trapping his brother, and although Jackie held his ground against the police, the intervention by Spider-Man led to Jackie's arrest and landed him in the Cage for the next 10 years. In that time, Vince received strength enhancements from the Consultant, an underworld provider of enhanced abilities and advanced weapons. He became Mister Pain, a high-ranking enforcer in the Owl's mob. In modern times, once Jackie Dio had been released from prison, in trying to get back into the underworld, Jackie was worked over by Vince. After the experience, Jackie targeted the Owl's operation and was manipulated by the Consultant into becoming the super-criminal known as Underworld. Vince's private vendetta against Jackie, and his desire to stop him from ruining Jackie's attempt to work for the Owl, led to a final confrontation between the two in which Jackie, thanks to his enhancements by the Consultant, was able to beat Mr. Pain, and killed him for all the trouble he'd given Jackie since getting out of prison.

vincent esquida.name: Vincent Esquida
vincent esquida.origin: Doctor Vincent Esquida was the scientist behind Project: W for Aladdin, a project designed to engineer and train Aladdin's own Ultra agent, the Wrath. Although Thomas Hunter was technically successful as the Wrath, Esquida wanted to move on to grander experiments with Ultra agents. When Colonel Carpenter and Aladdin's brass refused, Esquida was willing to have Hunter killed in order to clear up funding for his new projects. He arranged for the Radicals (a group of AWOL former agents who hated Hunter) to attack Wrath for him. When his plans failed, Doctor Esquida was terminated by Colonel Carpenter using a bomb.

vincent farnsworth.name: Vincent Farnsworth
vincent farnsworth.origin: Vincent Farnsworth was the company manager of , specialized in safes and vaults. At a club he frequented, he had an argument with Henry Marsh, who revealed to him his theory of powered people, the mutants, with abilities such as mind-reading, defying gravity or moving through walls. According to Marsh, most of them were unaware of their own powers, and the others kept them secret from normal men who would fear and distrust them. Farnsworth laughed at that theory, and departed to his office. There, a new vault was then sent into his office. Still thinking about Marsh's mutants, Farnsworth entered the safe in order to check his new product, and was accidentally trapped inside by Joe, the janitor. Suffocating in the safe, Farnsworth revealed himself a mutant by moving through the safe, saving himself. Understanding that he was one of the mutants, and why Marsh had stated they remained in secrecy, Farnsworth decided to remain hidden as well. One week later, Marsh and Farnsworth met again at the club, and while Marsh asked him again about his theory, Farnsworth pretended to still think the idea fake, while asking himself if Marsh was not a mutant himself.
powers: Farnsworth theorized that "in a moment of stress, some chemical reaction in [his] body must set off a force which enables [him] to move through solid matter".

vincent fasinera.name: Vincent Fasinera
vincent fasinera.origin: Vincent Fasinera met a nun and his soon to be wife Scarlet at a church, where Vincent came searching for a priest to forgive him for his actions. As the priest was away from the church at the time, Vincent instead clung to Scarlets robes and begged her for forgiveness instead. 6 months later, he and Scarlet are married and begin living together. Vincent, however, turns and begins mistreating Scarlet once they have fully settled together. Scarlet and Vince's son Joseph Fasinera is eventually born, yet Vincent shows little care for the boy. Ultimately, Vincent decides one night to rob a bank, shooting a guard in the process and is then shot dead in a police shootout on the churches doorsteps.

vincent frankenstein.name: Vincent Frankenstein
vincent frankenstein.origin: Frankenstein's Monster headed back to Geneva, where he encountered Vincent Frankenstein, Ernst Frankenstein's great-grandson. Vincent was served by Ivan, a monstrous hunchback. Vincent set out to find the Monster after hearing of his sittings and convinced the Monster to return with him to Castle Frankenstein. Vincent convinced the Monster he could transfer his brain into a more normal-looking body, and he convinced Ivan that he would then put his brain into the Monster's body. Vincent was not certain whether this was possible, but thought it a great opportunity for the Monster if it did succeed, and if it failed, it would still be great for science. Vincent, however, miscalculated the dose of anesthetic it would take for the Monster to be sedated, which resulted in the Monster being disoriented instead and Ivan being forced to subdue him. Fearing that Ivan would kill the Monster, Vincent shot and killed him.

vincent kruger.name: Vincent Kruger
vincent kruger.origin: Elderly, wheelchair-bound Vincent Kruger is left with a dilemma when his butler, Jeeves, becomes the latest in a long line of servants to storm off the property, due to fears of a locked room Kruger keeps in his home. While worrying about having to find another servant, Kruger is startled to when to find a mysterious man in his home. The man, balding with a heavily scarred face, introduces himself as Hauntly, and announces himself as Kruger's new servant. Confused, Kruger agrees, and the both of them turn in for the night. In the following days and weeks, Kruger grows more and more unhappy with Hauntly's presence, and his knowledge of Kruger's secret room. One morning, Hauntly informs Kruger that he has cancelled Kruger's newspaper delivery, broken his radio, and cut the telephone lines, cutting Kruger off from the outside world. Hauntly then reveals himself to actually be Kruger's former research partner Dr. Otto van Shorn. Van Shorn demands to know the secrets of Kruger's room, but Kruger refuses to tell him. Unrelented, van Shorn wheels Kruger out to the cliff behind his home and threatens to roll him over the edge. Kruger gives in, and directs van Shorn to the room. Giving van Shorn the key to the room, Kruger watches as he rushes inside to see his treasures, only to find an unseen horror. However, van Shorn forgets to remove the key from the lock, and Kruger slams the door behind him, locking van Shorn inside. As van Shorn pounds on the door, screaming in terror, Kruger thinks back to the last time he saw van Shorn. He recalls that some 30 years prior, he and van Shorn created a serum in their lab, dubbed Formula-X, that they believed was the key to eternal life. Kruger rushed into town to purchase small animals to test the formula on. However, van Shorn could not wait, and decided to forcibly test the formula on Kruger's wife and children, who were residing upstairs. When Kruger returned, van Shorn had vanished, and he discovered that Formula-X did not grant eternal life, but instead disrupted the natural growth and function of body cells. After the screams stop, Kruger then breaks the fourth wall and asks the audience if they really want to know what's in the room. He relents and opens the door to reveal the monstrous, fanged shadows of his wife and children.

Giving van Shorn the key to the room, Kruger watches as he rushes inside to see his treasures, only to find an unseen horror. However, van Shorn forgets to remove the key from the lock, and Kruger slams the door behind him, locking van Shorn inside. As van Shorn pounds on the door, screaming in terror, Kruger thinks back to the last time he saw van Shorn. He recalls that some 30 years prior, he and van Shorn created a serum in their lab, dubbed Formula-X, that they believed was the key to eternal life. Kruger rushed into town to purchase small animals to test the formula on. However, van Shorn could not wait, and decided to forcibly test the formula on Kruger's wife and children, who were residing upstairs. When Kruger returned, van Shorn had vanished, and he discovered that Formula-X did not grant eternal life, but instead disrupted the natural growth and function of body cells. After the screams stop, Kruger then breaks the fourth wall and asks the audience if they really want to know what's in the room. He relents and opens the door to reveal the monstrous, fanged shadows of his wife and children.

vincent mangano.name: Vincent Mangano
vincent mangano.origin: Vincent Mangano was a member of the Maggia crime family who helped run a drug trafficker operation. After one his men, John Bartoli, was confronted by the Punisher he had the man's house armed with explosives and after a successful deal, dropped Bartoli and his family off and then set off the explosives killing them. A month later, the Punisher tracked down one of his men Bobby Peculo, who killed himself to avoid revealing anything about Mangano and risking his family. To take out the Punisher, Mangano hired Paladin and after his first attempt failed, Mangano has Ralph Parlini released from jail to help. After this attempt failed, Mangano had Microchip kidnapped and brought to his mansion. Since Parlini had failed him, he attempted to kill Parlini's family in the same way as the Bartoli family but they were save by the Punisher and U.S.Agent. After they Punisher discovered Microchips's kidnapping they teamed up to take down Mangano. They managed to fight their way through the mansion and the Punisher killed Mangano with a grenade.

vincent martinelli.name: Vincent Martinelli
vincent martinelli.origin: A noted security specialist, Vince Martell was placed in the witness relocation plan after he testified against the mob in Philadelphia. Forced to leave his wife and under his new name "Vic Martinelli" later became Security Chief for Stark International. Martinelli has proved his worth to the company on numerous occasions with his "no-nonsense" pragmatic approach. Martinelli was pictured in public relations material at Stark International which led to the underworld to hire Blacklash to assassinate Martinelli. Assisted by Iron Man, Martinelli was able to escape from Backlash and incapacitate the villain. Martinelli continued to work for Stark International and later Stane International when it was under the auspices of Obadiah Stane. After losing his job, Martinelli fell back on his military intelligence background and eventually started working as an underground courier, transporting top-secret intel across the globe. He became involved with corrupt governments and even Hydra, at one point serving as a contractor for the terrorist organization. Martinelli's latest employee was a black market network called Source Control, which specialized in high-grade technology and weapons. When Source Control obtained the rings of the deceased Mandarin, Martinelli had a crisis of conscience and attempted to reach out to Iron Man and War Machine. After learning of Vic's actions, Source Control sent the Titanium Man after Martinelli. He brutally murdered Vic and retrieved the rings.
abilities: Skilled combatant and security specialist.

vincent roberts.name: Vincent Roberts
vincent roberts.origin: When jungle explorer Vincent Roberts goes missing his lover, the wealthy Alice Graham, insists on going to see Swami Krishna, a supposed mystic who claims to speak to the dead, to learn if he is alive or dead. When she tells this to her friends the Human Torch and Toro, they try to caution her against going, in the event that Krishna is really a fraud, but Alice won't listen. The Torch and Toro decide the best thing they can do to avoid Alice from being bled dry by a chestier is to try and find Vincent themselves. The Torch and Toro's hunch prove right as Swami Krishina is really a fraud that uses intricate props, special effects and actors to give the illusion that he is summoning the spirits of the dead, and he is prepared and eagerly awaits to swindle Alice Graham of her fortune with his false tales of Vincent Robert's fate. When Alice pays a visit, the Swami uses his tricks to "conjuring" an image of Vincent in the jungle being felled by a poison dart being shot by a native. Convincing Alice that Vincent is dead, Alice asks the Swami to summon his spirit back so she might see him again. When she offers to pay any price for this "dangerous task", the Swami tells her to come back the next day. Meanwhile, the Human Torch and Toro arrive in Africa and track down Vincent's last known location. Asking one of the natives they learn that Vincent had been taken ill but is now on the mend. Finding Vincent recovering in a hut they explain what happened and fly him back to the United States before the Swami can swindle Alice out of her fortune. As the Swami prepares to receive Alice for her visit the next day, the Torch, Toro and Vincent break into the Swami's parlour. They knock out the actors posing as Vincent and decide to give the Swami a good scare and force him to confess. When the Swami calls forth his actor posing as Vincent, it is the real Vincent who appears. Pretending to be a spirit, he calls out the Swami for defiling his eternal rest, sending the phony into a panic and he confesses to putting on the act. When Vincent reveals that it was all a ruse, the Swami tries to flee as he is reunited with Alice. However, before he can escape the Torch and Toro easily round him up and explain how he was so easily able to fool Alice with is tricks and special effects.

vincent sandhurst.name: Vincent Sandhurst
vincent sandhurst.origin: As head attorney to Cord Industries and its founder Drexel Cord, Vincent Sandhurst became more prominent in the company when Drexel Cord died, leaving his young daughter Janice Cord in charge of this significant industrial company. It was later revealed that Vincent had a disabled brother, Basil Sandhurst. Vincent felt —and was— responsible for Basil's accident which left him crippled and grotesquely disfigured. Vincent illegally took funds from Cord Industries and gave money to Basil in order for him to walk again. However, Basil used the funds and his unique genius to become the villainous "Controller". Vincent Sandhurst's circle of contemporaries shrank greatly. Drexel Cord and his daughter Janice were both deceased. His brother Basil has been in great mortal peril for most of his criminal career. Vincent was eventually dismissed from his influential position at Cord Industries. Vincent Sandhurst developed a great animosity for Tony Stark. Sandhurst assassinated The Mercenary, who was disguised as Stark at the time. In the aftermath of this assassination, Vincent Sandhurst also perished from a gunshot received by The Mercenary earlier.
abilities: He was a qualified lawyer. He also had knowledge of accounting, enough to embezzle funds.

vincent stewart.name: Vincent Stewart
vincent stewart.origin: ===Xavier Institute=== thumb|190px|left|Redneck's old powers The young mutant called Redneck was a student of the Xavier Institute. He came from a large family in Arkansas, experienced first hand violence against mutants, and became friends with fellow student Radian. Redneck was ready to fight Cassandra Nova as she made her second assault. Instead, Redneck became mentally controlled by Nova and was forced to fight the X-Men on her behalf. Redneck and the other students were freed soon after by the Stepford Cuckoos. Some time after, Redneck joined Quentin Quire, also known as Kid Omega, and his group. This small team of mutants was dubbed the Omega Gang. As the Omega Gang later attacked a small group of humans to avenge the mutant fashion designer Jumbo Carnation, Redneck used his powers to burn one of the humans. When Kid Omega and his gang started a riot at the Xavier Institute, Redneck was stopped by Cyclops, whose optic blasts broke his nose. As his punishment for his involvement in the riot, Redneck was sent to a prison run by humans. Redneck lost his mutant powers after the event called M-Day. ===New Warriors=== thumb|190px|right|Unmasked Vincent was later offered membership in the newest incarnation of the New Warriors. After being given a flight suit and new technological weaponry based on the designs of the Beetle to replace his lost powers he adopted the code-name Skybolt, and began training with the team, which included his former Omega Gang teammates Radian, now called Phaser and Tattoo, now using the code-name Longstrike. However, on one of the team's first missions out to stop the Zodiac, Longstrike got too cocky when fighting Cancer, and was brutally killed in front of the rest of the team. Vin didn't seem too saddened by Christine's death, even criticizing her work ethic in front of her brother almost immediately after her death. Although callous and harsh, he showed a commitment to the New Warriors and their cause and continued working alongside them. However, he was later killed in action by an explosion.

vincent varl.name: Vincent Varl
vincent varl.origin: Captain America is sitting in on a practice session of his friend musician Vincent Varl who plays classical music from his Amati violin. However his promoters are not interested and tell him that he should start playing Jazz music in order to boost popularity. Vincent is reluctant to play Jazz music on his Amati due to his artistic integrity, but eventually caves. However, later that night as he is practising the new music style something causes his notes to come out all wrong. Wondering why, Vincent is shocked when a tiny Imp comes out of his violin. The Imp informs him that he refuses to allow Vincent to play Jazz music in a classical Amati violin. The Imp tells him that he was in the workshop where the Amati was originally constructed in the 16th Century. Having fallen in love with its sound the Imp took possession of it and lived inside it before others of his kind could claim it for themselves. When the Imp returns to his home, Vincent tries to tell his wife who passess off the experience as nerves. Later, Vincent and Captain America pay a visit to a psychiatrist who tells Vincent that the Imp is likely a product of his subconscious, creating a hallucination to feed his doubts about playing Jazz music. Trying to appease the Imp, Vincent meets with his manager and asks to be able to play his music solo, the manager likes the idea of an Amati being played as part of a crooning number and accepts. When Vincent puts on his show, the Imp attempts to sabotage it and is instantly distracted by the chorus girls who are dancing on stage. Still the music is altered and although both Vincent and Cap believe that he did poorly they are both surprised when his performance gets rave reviews for its "unique" sound. Even more impressive, the Imp has now grown to appreciate Jazz music -- if only for the chorus girls who dance than anything else. And so, Vincent embraces his new found fame putting on shows while the Imp tries to dance along with the ladies in his show.

vincent von doom.name: Vincent von Doom
vincent von doom.origin: In a reality where the heroes and villains involved in the conflict known as the Secret Wars never returned to Earth from the site of the Wars, Battleworld, Vincent Von Doom was the son of Doctor Doom and Enchantress. Vincent's father had apparently killed his mother at some point in his adolescence. Vincent had a half-brother, Balder, from his mother's previous relationship with Thor, who she left for Vincent's father. Inheriting his father's lust for power, Vincent eventually slew him to take his place. He then organized a group of other children of the villains involved in the Secret Wars, and clashed with the children of the heroes, while sending robots to battle the adult heroes. During the conflict, Vincent fought his half-brother, and mocked him for his inferior sorcerous abilities. Nevertheless, Vincent was defeated. To add insult to injury, Doctor Doom, having foreseen his son's treachery appeared alive and well to spirit Vincent away for punishment.

vinnie corbo.name: Vinnie Corbo
vinnie corbo.origin: Vinnie Corbo was a small time gang leader inNew York City, he was mostly involved in prostitution. His life changed one day one of his girls, whose street name was Toots, encountered the Beyonder, a godlike being that came to Earth to learn about human desire. Seeing that he could create gold out of thin air, Toots went to get Vinnie. When Vinnie wanted answers from the Beyonder, the entity explained what it understood as its origins at the time and how it encountered Earth, and began the Secret Wars to learn about human desire. Failing to accomplish that, the Beyonder then came to Earth. Corbo, seeing a golden opportunity, convinced the Beyonder to work for him. Taking the near omnipotent being under his wing, Corbo showed him a life of decadence. The Beyonder earned a love of fine dining and became a glutton, and was educated in sex with a room full of hookers, and was given a new wardrobe. He'd repay Vinnie for this experience by helping Vinnie enforce his rackets, cure his prostitutes of sexually transmitted diseases, and create gold to fund his empire. The Beyonder was also asked to cure Corbo's son's dyslexia, as well as reform his wife to appear as she did when Corbo first married her. vinruviel.name: Vinruviel
vinruviel.species: Entity (Possibly Cosmic Being) created by itself, without the intervention of the One Above All
vinruviel.origin: ===Origin=== thumb|left|Mother Vinruviel The One Above All created Earth and the Demiurge Primordial, who seeded Earth with life, all according to the One Above All's design. The first of those creatures were the Elder Gods, who shaped Earth according to His design. Vinruviel, the Mother of Horrors was an entity that came to be from itself and not from the One Above All. The Mother of Horrors resented the One Above All for dominating over all of existence, and decided that the planet Earth, to which she was bound to, would not know His rule, only hers and that of her children. She hid Earth from the One Above All, and began filling it with her creation. ===Early years=== ====The Seed of Corruption==== With her coming, life began to change. She planted seeds of shadow within the sleeping Elder Gods. As the Mother's corruption changed the creatures of Earth, the Elder Gods grew into fearsome and hungry creatures, many of them eventually becoming demons. Gaea was one of the few creatures uncorrupted, and she loved the Volantine Choir, a race of winged creatures living atop great sunlit forests. Vinruviel came to the Volantine, corrupting them, allowing them to also be diggers, and them leading to ravage their forests to built tunnels, burrows, and the first city on Earth. She also blessed with great size and strength one of them, whom she named Gologolthia ("keeper of my children"). She created her oldest child. ====The Great Culling==== The One Above All came to notice that His creation had been corrupted. This is also attributed to Gaea who feared all life would be wiped out on Earth, as the Elder Gods' constant fighting prevented even her hardiest creations survived during the Godwar-. Either on Gaea's plea to the Demiurge, or on the One Above All's decision, Gaea and Demiurge produced the Demogorge, born as Atum. Wielding the powers of the Sun, Atum decimated the demons, absorbing their forms and energies. Eventually, Atum transformed into Demogorge the God-Eater. Vinruviel observed as the God-Eater culled the children of the One Above All, and was glad of it. The God-Eater kept on the Great Culling, destroying one by one the creations of the Mother of Horrors. He eventually came to the city of the Volantine Choir, killed Gologolthia, but was unable to find the Volantine who had fled underground. Gologolthia would rise anew, becoming the Living City of the Volantine. ====Age of Monsters==== After the Great Culling by the God-Eater, Vinruviel grew bolder, and she created life of her own. She spawned another being that she designed to mock the One Above All, which she named Udru, meaning "Brighter than He". Among the many children of the Mother of Horrors were Eldest's brothers Ngathil the God-Eater, Fielaskil, Keeper of Lost Knowledge, Filekthiman, Beast of Riddles, Djurnele, Lord of the Iron Lords, and the Old Ones /Great Old Ones, her immortal children. The One Above All eventually notice life that was not His own, including Udru. He lay waste to Vinruviel's children, ripping apart, bliding and disfiguring Udru, but could not find Vinruviel. ====The One Below All==== As the Mother of Horrors grew bolder, the One Above All, enraged, eventually confronted her with a spear made of His own Light, splitting the Earth in half in order to see what was going on. She took this opening to infect Him with her corruption, turning Him into the One Below All. In a rage, He proceeded to burn Vinruviel's children, then chaining the Mother of Horrors in the Requiem Plain, letting the corpses of her children as a warning to anyone who tried to free her, and hanging the heads of the immortal Old Ones lamenting and asking their Mother to kill them around the city that was built around the door holding the Mother, a door that could only be opened by the Green Flame. Eldest would spend the next eons trying to free her, but to no avail. She briefly succeeded circa 1600 BC when one of the One Below All's children, Enkidu, came to face her at Nineveh, Assyria. She managed to wear his flesh and was about to free Vinruviel, though the One Below All appeared and annihilated them. ===Modern Age=== However, when the Green Door was shut, the One Below All was isolated from the rest of the Multiverse. Later, a group of archaeologists found Enkidu's tomb, one of them being possessed by Eldest, returning to life and rekindling her quest to free mother Vinruviel, as a new Fractured Son was on the loose. The Eldest finally managed to possess him and open Vinruviel's door. However, she was unresponding, discouraged by the torture the One Below All inflicted upon her back then and the centuries of waiting. In a fit of rage, Eldest devoured her mother's flesh, assimilating her powers and becoming the Infernal Hulk. Since Eldest also possessed Vinruviel - or the other way around -, the Mother of Horrors became trapped within the Hulkscape along with the Hulk personas and everyone else Eldest possessed or consumed.

viorica.name: Viorica
viorica.origin: At the age of fifteen, Viorica was abducted from her small Moldovan village by the Bulat criminal syndicate. She was taken to a building in the suburbs of Chisinau, where she was brutally gang raped for 24 hours, before being forced into prostitution. At one point, Viorica managed to escape and even return to her village but, much to her dismay, was rejected by her father, who was ashamed of her. To make matters worse, she soon discovered that she was pregnant. When Viorica was recaptured, she was soon presented to Tiberiu Bulat, who bought her and two other girls and brought them to the U.S., where she was forced into prostitution once more. When she gave birth, Vera Konstantin took her baby away to insure her good behavior. Viorica was allowed to see her baby once a week. One day, Viorica escaped with her baby and attempted to get help from a social worker, but the social worker's computer was hacked by Vera, who kidnapped and killed her baby. Distraught, Viorica attempted to kill Antony Pavla, an Albanian mobster who was working with the slaving ring, but was saved by the Punisher from his men. After the Punisher eliminated the slaving ring, Viorica was given citizenship and found work as a waitress, although she was still heavily traumatized from the abuse she went through.

vira tode.name: Vira (Tode)
vira tode.origin: Queen Vira was a Deviant who met and married Brother Tode, a high ranking male Deviant. Brother Tode bided his time until the opportunity arose for him to seize power, becoming the King of the Deviants. Vira was with her husband when he ordered Kro to go find the Celestials' cosmic beacon in an attempt to prevent them from returning to Earth. When Kro returned a failure he was tortured in front of the Deviant royal family. After the torture he begged for forgiveness and promised that he would return to the humans and trick them in the form of their devil so that they would attack the Celestials. Vira was present during a gladiatorial game between Ransak the Reject and Karkas the Mutate. Later when the Eternal Thena visited to take part in the games she was disgusted by what she considered haughty treatment. The Royal family survived the flooding of the City of Toads, the capital city of Lemuria. This event was caused by Eson. The royal family made their new home under the streets of New York City. When Kro once again tried to win over the royal court by capturing the Eternals and their ally Thor however, he was once again stopped and their new home destroyed. Tode left his wife Vira fleeing with his lover Dragona. Vira joined the rest of the Deviants in an attack on the city of Olympia, the home of the Eternals. They were defeated by the Eternals with help from Iron Man (James Rhodes). She and the Deviants from the City of Toads were all molecularly rearranged into a large organic cube and cast into space by the Uni-Mind.

virako.name: Virako
virako.origin: ===Origin=== A powerful Eternal, Virako is a Polar Eternal, alongside Valkin, Druig and Ajak. In the distant past, approximately 1,000 years ago, the quartet of Eternals came to know and bond with the Asgardian thunder god Thor. Power mad and deceptive, Druig's schemes and machinations brought about the release of three extremely dangerous Deviants; Dromedan, Thunder and Tutinax. In addition, the as-powerful psychic also unleashed a devastating creature known as the World-Devouring Worm. This creature started to grow at an exponential rate, growing the more it devoured. Virako heroically sacrificed himself to neutralize the threat of the World-Devouring Worm by launching himself directly into its mouth, while charged and brimming with energy. Virako is the father of the Eternal Ikaris. Recently resurrected, he aided his long-time friend Thor after a power vacuum in the Deviants' leadership caused several Deviants to look for ways to acquire power, both raw and political. This brought several of the Deviants, such as Kro and Ereshkigal, to interfere and cause chaos in the affairs of both Eternals, Asgardians and Earthlings. After aiding the thunder god, Virako, alongside Ransak and Karkas, was present at the return of the Eternals to New Olympia. After the Mad Titan Thanos was resurrected by the Exclusion, he began going on a killing spree, wiping out various Eternals. After traveling to the city of Polaria, Thanos wiped out many of its inhabitants, including Virako.

virginia hunter.name: Virginia Hunter
virginia hunter.first_appearance: Peter Parker, The Spectacular Spider-Man Vol 1 55
virginia hunter.origin: Virginia was the daughter of Mary and Robert Hunter, also known as the villain Nitro. When her father Nitro was given to Project P.E.G.A.S.U.S. by federal authorities for use in the facility's energy experiments, Virginia hired the attorney Emerson Bale to have her father's custody transferred to her. Once Nitro was released from his containment, he exploded and escaped in her car with his daughter and her lawyer, both unconscious. Nitro brought them to his daughter's apartment, where she attempted to convince her father to let Emerson help him; however, at the mention of help Nitro became enraged, smacking Virginia for trying to help him by having him committed. He then pressured Virginia and Emerson into telling him the location of the superhero Captain Marvel so that he could enact his revenge. Emerson told Nitro that Captain Marvel returned to Denver, so Nitro left Emerson tied up in Virginia's apartment, dragging her with him on a bank robbery in order to get enough money to travel to Denver in pursuit of Captain Marvel. However, at the bank Nitro encountered and battled Spider-Man. Spider-Man neutralized Nitro by causing his gaseous form to bond with nausea gas, leaving him sickened. The police arrested Nitro, and he was loaded into an ambulance to be taken to Bellevue hospital. Spider-Man apologized to Virginia for hurting her father, but Virginia understood and was just glad that her father was apprehended before hurting anyone else. Virginia then accompanied her father to the hospital.
